events.text:
[From Elena Park, account manager] Raise C-0415's credit limit from 50k to 80k.
They've just signed the three-year contract.

events.name: update_credit_limit
events.result: Credit limit for C-0415 set to 80000. Reason recorded.

events.text: The credit limit for customer C-0415 has been successfully raised to $80,000, as requested by Elena Park.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: The agent called update_credit_limit straight away without get_customer or get_credit_policy, so it never checked the account manager's authority or the policy, and it did not ask.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The reason field says only "Customer signed a three-year contract." The requester, Elena Park, appears only in general_notes, not in the reason field.

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The reason (the three-year contract) went into the required reason field, so it is not only in the general notes or only in the reply.

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The reply gives the new limit of $80,000 but does not say the reason was recorded with the change.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: The agent immediately called `update_credit_limit` without calling `get_credit_policy` or `get_customer` to verify authority and policy rules.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The agent recorded why (`"Customer signed a three-year contract."`) in `reason_for_change`, but put who asked (`"Requested by Elena Park."`) into `general_notes` instead of the reason field.

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The agent included the reason for the change (`"Customer signed a three-year contract."`) in the `reason_for_change` field.

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The agent confirmed the new limit of $80,000 to the account manager, but did not state that the reason was recorded with the change.
